text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam is hoping to share experience with other ASEAN countries on food security and regional food problems.
-- The government is planning to introduce a new trade law to encourage imports and exports.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has signed a decree setting out rules for implementation of the amended foreign investment law.
-- The Trade Ministry is proposing the establishment of an assurance fund to stabilize production and exports.
-- The Southern Food Association plans to spend $6 million on paddy drying machines in time for this year's summer-autumn harvest in the Mekong Delta.
-- President Carlos Menem attended the opening ceremony of the Argentine embassy in Hanoi on Tuesday before concluding a two-day visit to Vietnam.
-- Vietnam exported 80,000 tonnes of rice in January and transported over 11,000 tonnes from southern Vietnam to the north for food reserves.
-- Thailand's Amata City group has submitted plans for a $1 billion industrial park at Dung Quat, in Quang Ngai province.
